name: freehands-tools
description: Practical, read-only-first plugins for FreeHands/Oli: repository health, release notes, mobile UI review and dependency upgrades.

plugins.name: repo-health-audit
plugins.description: Audit a repository's build, tests, lint, TODOs and dependency risk, then write a prioritised health report.

plugins.name: git-release-notes
plugins.description: Turn git history since the last tag into grouped, user-facing release notes.

plugins.name: mobile-ui-review
plugins.description: Open a web app on a real cloud Android phone, drive it, and capture screenshots as review evidence.

plugins.name: dependency-upgrade-check
plugins.description: Find outdated and vulnerable dependencies, then prepare a safe, tested upgrade plan.
